question: A karyotype 45, XX, rob (15; 21) (q10; q10) can correspond to:

options.opa: A girl with Down syndrome with a Robertsonian translocation.
options.opc: A healthy woman with a Robertsonian translocation.
options.opd: A healthy woman with Turner syndrome.
options.ope: A healthy male carrier of a Robertsonian translocation.
